d: Short, ash-brown hair is tucked under a tan cap, while narrow, sharp amber eyes peer through yellow-tinted tactical glasses. The face appears as a mature adult with a focused, stern expression and a lean, athletic build. The outfit consists of a tan hooded shirt under a brown tactical plate carrier with multiple ammo pouches, paired with tan camouflage cargo pants, brown knee pads, and brown lace-up boots. Signature details include a tan baseball cap, a headset, fingerless tactical gloves, a side-holstered handgun, and a large, tan futuristic sniper rifle held in one arm.
